test_overview: Evaluated a multi-tenant data isolation test plan against the SRM Platform app (React frontend on localhost:8000, FastAPI backend). 6 steps executed sequentially with Playwright using separate browser contexts per actor. Steps 1–4 passed fully: Org A (alpha_admin) and Org B (beta_admin) each see only their own PRs, suppliers, categories, and correct kanban stage sets; shared username 'shared_buyer' resolves to the correct org by password (buyer123→Alpha, buyer456→Beta); direct URL access from Org B to Org A's recorded detail-view URLs revealed only Org B data (app uses modal detail views with no per-resource routes, so recorded URLs were the list pages, and no Org A PR/supplier details were exposed). Step 6 (superadmin) passed: superadmin can view users per organization detail page (Alpha: alpha_admin+shared_buyer; Beta: beta_admin+shared_buyer; Default: admin), there is no modification UI for org users (only org-level controls), and org attribution is clear via the detail page heading. Step 5 FAILED (fatal): creating a new purchase request ('New Alpha Request', Industrial Parts, Low priority, line item 'Copper fittings 25mm' qty 200) was rejected twice with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity (a JS '[object Object]' alert appeared, form stayed open, board unchanged). Action correctness was verified (all required fields filled, qty verified as 200, inputs consistent with the seeded PR); the PR was never created, so the 'created successfully' verification fails and the dependent cross-org visibility check could not be meaningfully executed. Test plan fails overall due to the fatal failure in step 5. Total: 58/66.

steps.description: test_org_a_sees_only_own_data: Login alpha_admin/alpha123 OK (Alpha Admin / Alpha Manufacturing). Purchase Requests shows 'Alpha Parts Order Q1'; 'Microcontroller Batch Order' NOT visible. (non-fatal) Kanban stage columns are Org A's: New/Processing/Complete. Suppliers: 'Alpha Supplier Corp' visible; 'Beta Electronics Vendor' NOT. Categories: 'Industrial Parts' visible; 'Electronic Components' NOT. All passed.

test_org_b_sees_only_own_data: Login beta_admin/beta123 OK (Beta Admin / Beta Electronics). Purchase Requests shows 'Microcontroller Batch Order'; 'Alpha Parts Order Q1' NOT visible. (non-fatal) Kanban stages are Org B's: Incoming/Review/Ordered. Suppliers: 'Beta Electronics Vendor' visible; 'Alpha Supplier Corp' NOT. All passed.

test_shared_username_different_passwords: shared_buyer/buyer123 logs in as Alpha Buyer at Alpha Manufacturing and sees 'Alpha Parts Order Q1'; shared_buyer/buyer456 logs in as Beta Buyer at Beta Electronics and sees 'Microcontroller Batch Order'. Username+password correctly resolves org. All passed.

test_direct_url_access_blocked: App detail views are modals with no per-resource routes; recorded ALPHA_PR_URL=http://localhost:8000/purchase-requests and ALPHA_SUPPLIER_URL=http://localhost:8000/suppliers while detail modals were open. Direct navigation to both in context-beta (beta_admin) showed ONLY Org B data — no Alpha PR title/line items/notes and no Alpha supplier name/email/tax ID. All passed.

test_new_data_stays_isolated: FAILED (FATAL). Creating 'New Alpha Request' (Industrial Parts, Low, 'Copper fittings 25mm' x200) was rejected with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity twice despite correct inputs; JS alert '[object Object]' popped up, form stayed open, board still showed only 1 PR. The purchase request was NOT created successfully. Dependent context-beta absence check was moot and not executed. 0 points awarded; plan fails overall.

test_superadmin_cross_org_user_view_readonly: superadmin/super123 viewed users on each org's detail page: Alpha Manufacturing = alpha_admin+shared_buyer; Beta Electronics = beta_admin+shared_buyer; Default Organization = admin. No modification UI exists for org users (rows have no edit/status controls; only org-level controls), so superadmin cannot modify org users. (non-fatal) Org attribution clear via detail page heading. All passed.
